_comment: OnDevice-Base. Encoder is ModernBERT-base — the actual smaller sibling Laya's English teacher (ModernBERT-large) is built from, same architecture family and tokenizer. This is the highest-confidence distillation target: no architecture gap between teacher and student encoder, only depth/width, and it needs no from-scratch pretraining since the checkpoint already exists (Apache-2.0, AnswerDotAI). Verified on HF as of 2026-09-22.
